description: The list of service registrations (`builder.Services`) that plays the role of Magento's merged `di.xml`, written in C#.
A lifetime where the container creates a new instance every time the service is requested.
A lifetime with one instance per scope, which in ASP.NET Core means one instance per HTTP request.
A lifetime with one instance for the whole process, which must therefore be thread-safe.
A shorter-lived service, such as a scoped repository, held by a longer-lived one, such as a singleton, so it outlives its intended scope.
A check the host enables in Development that throws when a scoped service is injected into a singleton or resolved from the root provider.
A singleton that creates explicit scopes, the correct way for a singleton or background service to use scoped services.
A registration identified by a key, resolved with `[FromKeyedServices(key)]`, used to pick one of several implementations of the same interface.
